meta.name: overgrown_hideout
meta.prompt: A high-tech apocalyptic hideout in the massively overgrown ruins of a metropolis.

programs.brief: An enterable high-tech refuge hidden in the massively reclaimed ruins of a dead metropolis: a compact low brutalist bunker embedded into an abandoned city block, with dark concrete, polished metal, luminous cyan conduit bands, sealed blast doors, rooftop antenna masts and a defended entrance facing the city. Hollow it into a dry control room, sleeping quarters, power room and stores, and publish the main entrance as a door anchor.

tokens.setting: A technologically advanced hideout embedded in the massively overgrown ruins of a metropolis; the surrounding city is post-apocalyptic and heavily reclaimed by vegetation.
